name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is a local-first AI voice studio for voice cloning, speech generation, dubbing, transcription and audiobooks. It provides a browser-based interface backed by a self-hosted inference service.

notes.text: The administrator API key is stored in /opt/voicestudio_data/.env as OMNIVOICE_API_KEY. For first browser access, append #api_key=<key> to the VoiceStudio URL; the browser exchanges it for a session.
This installation uses CPU-only PyTorch. Speech generation can be slow with larger engines; install smaller CPU-friendly engines for better responsiveness.
Voice models are downloaded when selected in VoiceStudio and are stored under /opt/voicestudio_data/huggingface. Allow additional disk space for models.
